Review the worksheet, export, save and reopen; distinguish source references and the historical local Mac build from a fresh installed-version test.

measurement.interpretation: Clicks and disclosure opens are intent or engagement, not verified download completion, app installation, activation or purchase.
measurement.privacy: Existing analytics consent gating, fixed guide/evidence/plans targets and source labels. No new storage, document contents, identity joins, marketing sends or recurring paid collection.
measurement.limitations: No fresh Search Console, OpenSEO ranking, AI-citation or GA4 conversion baseline. No uplift is claimed.

validation.linkChecks: Actual nonempty source PDF, three steps, three existing destination fragments for every module; translated summaries differ from English.
validation.visualLimitation: Native Screen Sharing selection timed out twice after resetting the CUA runtime. App/browser inventory succeeded; no new visual screenshots or iPad hardware run completed.
validation.scope: Website only. No installer, app package, API, update-feed or server configuration changes.

navigation.accessibilityLimit: Static accessibility excludes color contrast; does not establish visual layout correctness.

followUp: Compare equal periods of consented download intent, sample and guide engagement, and verified Pro purchases once the PolyPDF analytics property is accessible. Keep desktop activation separate.
